comparison.objective: Orient and stack empty stack-nest totes without disturbing contents; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-object reorientation, alignment and placement versus small-tool insertion, fine rotation, counterholding and force control.
comparison.success_condition: Both totes supported on ledges without nesting or parts movement versus two safe physical cycles with a locked stable setting.
comparison.reason: Orientation-sensitive stacking is unrelated to dynamic mechanical tuning. Candidate’s missing numeric rebound, overload and drift thresholds do not create plausible duplication.
